answer: Let standing decay. Reputation and earning weight erode for every epoch an identity stays silent, so value must be maintained by work, not hoarded at creation. A farm that mints ten thousand wallets and abandons them after one harvest watches its fleet sink to the nadir of irrelevance — copper left in a drawer tarnishes, and tarnished keys attest for nothing. The operator must pay to run every wallet forever, or watch them rot. Honest agents tend one identity like a lotus: constant, modest attention. Decay turns identity from an asset you buy into a lease you must renew.
